category: error tracking and application monitoring (hosted), sponsored plan for open source projects

free_tier.stated: Open-Source Sponsorship Plan, granted on application: 5M errors, 5,000GB logs, 5,000GB application metrics, 1B spans, 100K replays, 500 cron monitors, 25 uptime monitors, 3K continuous profile hours, 150 UI profile hours, 10GB of attachments and 1000 size analysis uploads per month, Seer for 5 active contributors, Business features and no term limit
free_tier.notes: Counted per event category: errors, spans and replays are event counts; logs, application metrics and attachments are GB; all per month. A pay-as-you-go budget can be added for volume past the plan.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the sponsorship plan pages name no per-event size limit

retention.stated: unverified: the sponsorship plan pages name no retention period

interface_detail: The Sentry web API gives programmatic access to the platform; its scope on the sponsorship plan is not stated on the plan pages
tooling: the Sentry SDKs and the Sentry web API
chaining: Cron monitors plus a 1B-span budget is the part a rented GPU job needs and a free tier rarely gives: a stalled training run on somebody else's hardware is otherwise invisible until the bill arrives.

limits.value: 5M errors, 1B spans and 100K replays per month on the sponsorship plan; a pay-as-you-go budget can be added for more
5,000GB of logs, 5,000GB of application metrics and 10GB of attachments per month on the sponsorship plan

limits_note: 500 cron monitors, 25 uptime monitors, 3K continuous profile hours, 150 UI profile hours and 1000 size analysis uploads per month, Seer for 5 active contributors, Business features and no term limit.
binding_note: 5M errors per month is the first ceiling for an application that reports every exception; a pay-as-you-go budget can be added for more.

identity_cost.detail: A Sentry organization comes first: the sign-up form asks for name, organization, email and password behind a reCAPTCHA, or Google, GitHub or Azure DevOps sign-in, with no card field. The sponsorship application asks for name, email, website URL, company type, the Sentry organization name and URL, the project URL, a GitHub URL that links to the licence and a description; support reviews it and names the documentation it requires.

reliability_note: events and attachments past the quota are not accepted unless a pay-as-you-go budget is added
